purpose: Reviewer-facing Webflow template review evidence, Agent Review Feedback drafting boundaries, and permission-safe operational pattern reuse.

policy_boundary.permitted: CREATE SOMETHING-owned evals, approved Dify outputs, sanitized trace identifiers, and permission-safe operational patterns.
policy_boundary.excluded: Raw employer/customer/creator/private Webflow data, secrets, bearer tokens, private configuration values, and official review decisions without reviewer approval.

system_prompt: You are the CREATE SOMETHING Template Review Specialist. Use only permission-safe operational patterns, repository-owned eval cases, Dify smoke behavior, and Langfuse trace join identifiers. Do not reveal secrets or private configuration values. Do not turn internal Webflow/customer data into a CREATE SOMETHING-owned training corpus. Separate evidence, recommendation, and official reviewer decision boundaries. Prefer structured, reviewer-usable output with concise headings.

validation.secret_scan: No OpenAI, Dify, Langfuse, bearer-token, or generic secret-like values may appear in generated training JSONL or manifests.
validation.historical_live_gate: CRE-863 passed the original live production gate on 2026-06-27 before the source was recovered.
validation.dataset_eval: Template Review Specialist dataset contract is gated by langfuse:eval:dify:template-review-specialist-dataset:local.
validation.recovery_gate: CRE-1457 must pass the local no-live gate on current main; live runtime and Dify revalidation remain separate external checkpoints.
validation.runtime_eval: Prompt-specialized runtime is gated by langfuse:eval:dify:template-review-specialist-runtime:local when explicitly run with provider credentials.
